Place certification PDF files in this folder.

Recommended filenames use lowercase words and hyphens:

  ibm-generative-ai-engineering.pdf
  build-rag-applications.pdf

Then add the relative path to the matching record in data.js:

  certificateUrl: "./certificates/ibm-generative-ai-engineering.pdf"

External Coursera credential URLs also work:

  certificateUrl: "https://www.coursera.org/account/accomplishments/..."
